rows.label: qst500801_msg0001
rows.name:
Rex has changed a lot since I last
saw him, mo.

rows.label: qst500801_msg0002
rows.name:
Looks like you even made a rare
Nopon Driver friend, mo.

rows.label: qst500801_msg0003
rows.name:
Let me tell you about Noporikh, a
highly skilled Nopon Driver, mo.

rows.label: qst500801_msg0004
rows.name:
I just said Nopon Drivers are rare,
but...

rows.label: qst500801_msg0005
rows.name:
Before becoming a Driver, Noporikh
was an excellent salvager, mo.

rows.label: qst500801_msg0006
rows.name: Much like Rex is now, mo.

rows.label: qst500801_msg0007
rows.name:
When monsters appeared during salvage,
Noporikh cut them down with the power
of a Blade, mo.

rows.label: qst500801_msg0008
rows.name:
For a time, Noporikh was even known
as a Legend Salvager, mo.

rows.label: qst500801_msg0009
rows.name:
But life wasn't all smooth sailing,
mo.

rows.label: qst500801_msg0010
rows.name:
That day was unusually clear, perfect
weather for salvaging, mo.

rows.label: qst500801_msg0011
rows.name:
Then dark clouds suddenly gathered,
fog rolled in, hail fell, and thunder
started rumbling.

rows.label: qst500801_msg0012
rows.name:
No one has seen Noporikh since then,
mo...

rows.label: qst500801_msg0013
rows.name:
Some say Noporikh was eaten by
Gluttonous Marlin while trying to
turn back, mo.

rows.label: qst500801_msg0014
rows.name:
Point is, no matter how skilled a
salvager you become, never let your
guard down, mo.

rows.label: qst500801_msg0015
rows.name:
And there are reports of Gluttonous
Marlin in Superbia's Hanzag Wastes,
so stay alert, mo.
